description: Eurolite LED PT-100/32 Pixel DMX Tube (32 RGB pixels of 3 LEDs). In the 48CH mode two neighbouring pixels share one colour, so that mode has 16 pixels. Modes: 3CH, 5CH, 8CH, 48CH, 96CH; 96CH is the default. Built from the manual (this fixture is not in the Open Fixture Library) with the same conversion as the Open Fixture Library types.
